description: HP-49 is the official registration code for the Banjar sub-division in the Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh. This Registration & Licensing Authority (R&LA) office manages vehicle registration and driving licenses for the Tirthan Valley and surrounding mountainous regions. It operates under the administrative jurisdiction of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Banjar.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Banjar, District Kullu, Himachal Pradesh - 175123
